name: sim_pytorch_autograd_gradient_micro

micro_packet.micro_claim: autograd.grad computes exact first and second derivatives for one tiny scalar constraint and rejects detached/non-scalar misuse
micro_packet.lego_target: minimal differentiable scalar fixture; no lego promotion
micro_packet.why_this_lego: a weighted quadratic exposes gradient, Hessian, flat-axis boundary, and misuse rejection without graph or density-matrix uncertainty
micro_packet.positive_case: gradient and Hessian diagonal match analytic values
micro_packet.negative_case: detached inputs and vector outputs without grad_outputs are excluded
micro_packet.boundary_case: zero-weight axis produces an admitted zero gradient, not NaN
micro_packet.demotion_condition: demote this surface if gradients silently detach, lose second-order structure, or fail to reject invalid autograd requests
